# D01-only source contract

2026-09-09 UTC. SOURCE_ONLY / INDEPENDENT_RECEPTION_PENDING / HOLD_OPERATIONAL.
Author: /root/round211_finite_matching_scout. This is not an independent
review of my own launcher. The research skill requires original-source
reception and preserves old evidence; it does not grant this diagnostic.

## Exactly one proposed action

The only child argv is `['/usr/bin/ssh', '-V']`, directly supplied to Popen
with shell=False, stdin=DEVNULL (EOF), binary stdout/stderr pipes,
close_fds=True and start_new_session=True. There is no connection target,
configuration option, repository command, D02, callback, retry or successor.
The surrounding ordinary product may use the explicitly selected non-login
/bin/bash launcher interface; no shell interprets the SSH argv. Fixed cwd is
/root/autodl-tmp/symbolic_dynamics.

The SSH environment consists of genuine present HOME, USER, LOGNAME,
SSH_AUTH_SOCK and SSH_AGENT_PID, preserving every absence, plus only
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, LANG=C, LC_ALL=C and TZ=UTC. No absent value is invented.
Root must privately bind the exact old accepted five-role map, two complete
regular-role records and accepted python3 alias. This source author has read
only workspace archival representations, not private originals or current
environment. No configuration, Git role, host-key, agent or socket path is
opened or followed by the launcher.

## Selection and finite input boundary

The final launcher is 327 lines / 17,513 bytes, SHA256
b1b39b9ce36f9c7ace171229c6e69ba236e888bf2664e81eab9d557fd69468ce.
GRANT.disabled.json has the exact fifteen-key format but cannot be used:
false enable/trust flags and null private selections are deliberate.
A new independent source receipt and a separate exact root diagnostic
decision must precede any invocation. A private grant must be a new
single-linked root-owned 0600 regular original at the constrained grant
path, with an externally selected whole SHA256 passed as the last argument.
Source/runtime receipt references must be genuine complete path/bytes/SHA
references checked by root; the launcher records but neither follows nor
self-certifies them.

The only regular input roles are that private grant, this exact source,
/usr/bin/ssh and /usr/bin/python3.10. The existing python3 alias is separately
required to have the literal target python3.10. Both regular tool records
must match HISTORICAL_ROLE_KEYS.json in bytes/SHA/Git executable-mode/blob OID,
and match the entire selected private observation including its ten fields.
Those fields are dev, ino, mode, nlink, uid, gid, rdev, size, mtime_ns and
ctime_ns, represented as decimal strings; atime is excluded.

Each regular input is read completely before the child, and again through
the same descriptor after it, with lexical/opened/end/after key equality,
physical-parent checks and exact byte length. Tool reads have a 32 MiB
per-read ceiling; source/grant reads have 64 KiB. Only four regular roles
and their endpoint rereads exist, not a recursive dependency frontier.
The private output is a new exclusive root-selected 0700 directory, never
an existing directory, under root-owned 0700 /root. All files use exclusive
0600 creation and directory-relative held descriptors. No old file is
overwritten or deleted.

## Native budget, closure and partial failure

The normal phase ends at 14 seconds after successful Popen return. If still
needed, one owned-session TERM is attempted, with communication to absolute
offset 17; then one owned-session KILL, to offset 19; then final drain to
offset 20. Every remaining communicate call has its finite absolute budget.
This resumes capture of the same child, never launches another child.
Any timeout, elapsed-budget overrun, cancellation or exception permanently
prevents success even if the child later exits zero.

Before a group signal, poll must show the direct child unreaped and both
observed pgid and sid must equal its pid. A reaped leader is never permission
to search for or signal a residual group. Unknown ownership means no signal.
No process search, broad kill, fallback child or automatic cleanup is used.
A nonzero/unknown return code or missing pipe EOF is failure/unclosed.
The launcher does not prove that a detached descendant cannot exist.

ATTEMPT and raw output files are created before spawning. SPAWN records the
actual pid immediately after successful spawn; its write failure remains a
failure and does not skip bounded child handling. NATIVE records returned
whole binary streams or explicitly incomplete cumulative timeout data,
native status, signal events and EOF. A result can only say native-closed /
root-reception-pending, never root accepted. Unhandled outer process
termination or filesystem failure can leave only partial private evidence;
missing files and a tool yield never establish no-child or completion.

This is a finite native communication/handling budget, not a hard real-time
or full-launch SLA. Product/shell/Python startup, Popen creation, filesystem
reads/writes/fsync and scheduling may exceed it or fail. communicate buffers
output in memory; no independent byte or RAM bound is claimed. Root must
accept the ordinary small version-banner workload premise or request a
different source. Early failures are retained, never retried automatically.

## Ordinary trust and mandatory root reception

Product, shell, interpreter, standard library, filesystem, kernel and the
selected tool are ordinarily trusted. Imports and interpreter startup occur
before internal checks; downstream flags and endpoint hashes do not attest
ELF/NSS/import closure, initial environment handling, uninterrupted execution
identity, hostile races or continuous immutability. Reading may alter atime.
A version banner does not certify vendor-source correspondence, option
support/defaults, authentication, absence of all startup effects or effective
policy. No observer-of-observer or strict P212 runtime claim is introduced.

Raw ENV5, tool output, private metadata and failure text stay in the private
grant/evidence only. Public output consists of status, content hashes/byte
counts and role counts, never private values, raw banner or private paths.
Root must retain each actual outer request/yield/poll/final return, receive
the exact private originals and complete directory inventory, check actual
native and outer closure, and produce a separate finite nonself receipt.
The launcher does not seal or accept itself. Do not infer authority from a
grant-shaped document or from exit 0 alone.

The remaining root choices are the ordinary trust acceptance, new source
receipt, genuine prior-private role selection, new exclusive token/path and
one exact enclosing request. No diagnostic, checkpoint capture/stage/commit/
push, P212 operation, scientific build or external action is authorized here.

# D01 preparation handoff

SOURCE_ONLY / ROOT_RECEPTION_PENDING / HOLD_OPERATIONAL, 2026-09-09 UTC.

The requested compact direct-argv launcher and disabled exact grant are
ready for independent source reception. Final source: 327 lines, 17,513
bytes, SHA256 b1b39b9ce36f9c7ace171229c6e69ba236e888bf2664e81eab9d557fd69468ce.
The declared source is the whole file, not the earlier pre-refinement read.

CONTRACT.md makes the 14/3/2/1 budget, ordinary bootstrap trust, private ENV5
selection and failure/unclosed outcomes explicit. HISTORICAL_ROLE_KEYS.json
is derived from actual complete workspace records, with SSH before/after
four-key equality; it is not a fresh tool or private-original observation.
The actual source reads, documentary reads and five input-seal checks are
retained as native request/return records. Fourteen exact input hashes are
pinned. Any later receipt must inspect the original source and evidence,
not accept this author summary as an independent review.

No SSH, Git, launcher, observer, probe, syntax/AST/import/test, private-original,
current environment or tool-binary read was performed for this source-only
task. No old file, binding, setting, credential, manuscript or central index
was modified. Only this new owned packet was written. The source was refined
before sealing to preserve immediate SPAWN failure as failure while still
entering bounded owned-child handling; no failed execution is concealed.

Document displays were selected, not an exhaustive transcript. One combined
five-document display and one web-plus-observer display were clipped by the
outer display limit; retained per-command results are complete. The old
READONLY_ROLE_RESULT was read in two complete adjacent slices (1–260 and
261–520, actual EOF 270). The final launch.py was displayed in two adjacent
slices (1–175 and 176–400). A prior 322-line source read predates the final
refinement and is not the final-source evidence. The orientation index
search was clipped and supplies no substantive proof.

The research skill kept the work source-first and change-scoped, preserving
old accepted originals and the separate execution gate. Root must still
choose and receive the exact private grant and enclosing invocation after
independent source acceptance. D02 and every checkpoint phase remain HOLD.
